confidence_rationale: Authoritative review establishing that value-driven (model-based/goal-directed) and stickiness-driven (model-free/habitual) control are dissociable constructs with distinct task signatures, and that compulsive behaviour is a transdiagnostic shift toward model-free control. This grounds Q-063's central premise -- that there IS a separable distinction between a high-value legitimately-repeated goal and a field-state-driven compulsive loop -- and supplies the established behavioural-economic vocabulary (outcome devaluation, model-based vs model-free) for the diagnostic Q-063 wants to build. Down-weighted because it is a conceptual review, not a direct test of REE's specific decommit-friction/modulator-bias mechanism (MECH-369), and offers no operationalisation of the offline-integration leg.
failure_signatures: Model-free control is 'autonomous of the current outcome value' -- so a loop that persists when its goal has been devalued is, by this framework, the signature of stickiness rather than value; if REE's diagnostic cannot devalue the goal and observe persistence, it cannot make Voon's dissociation.

The review frames the shift as transdiagnostic and graded, not categorical -- warning that Q-063's 'valued vs trapped' cells may be ends of a continuum, so a binary diagnostic risks false dichotomisation.

mapping.source_claim_statement: Daily decisions arise from parallel interacting goal-directed (model-based, prospective, outcome-sensitive) and habitual (model-free, retrospective, outcome-insensitive) strategies; their arbitration is relevant to inflexible repetitive behaviours, and a shift toward model-based deficit / model-free dominance is a transdiagnostic mechanism underlying compulsive behaviours.
mapping.ree_translation: Supports Q-063's foundational assumption that value-driven persistence and field-state-driven stickiness are genuinely separable. The model-based / model-free dissociation, and especially outcome-devaluation insensitivity as the marker of habitual (stickiness) control, is the established analogue of the z_goal-salience-and-closure-operator diagnostic Q-063 proposes.
mapping.mapping_caveat: A conceptual review, not a direct test; it dissociates model-based vs model-free but does NOT address REE's specific hypothesis that the stickiness is driven by a slow-modulator bias on the decommit-friction/threshold landscape (MECH-369) versus by value. The model-free construct is broader than 'modulator-trapped'.
mapping.source_context: Review of human + animal computational-psychiatry tasks across addictions, binge eating, OCD.

confidence_components.notes: High-authority review; mapping_fidelity moderate because it grounds the separability premise but not REE's specific modulator-bias mechanism.
